dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Acute small dorsal paramedian midbrain ischemic infarction involving the right oculomotor fascicle/nucleus, causing a pupil-sparing partial right oculomotor nerve palsy (oculomotor “pseudo-INO”)

ALTERNATIVE 1: Ocular myasthenia gravis

ALTERNATIVE 2: Medial longitudinal fasciculus infarction causing an atypical internuclear ophthalmoplegia

ALTERNATIVE 3: Compressive right oculomotor nerve palsy from an occult aneurysm or mass lesion
